verdict.rationale: Angular Signals (angular-docs-1) provide fine-grained, explicit reactive state tracking that replaces older implicit two-way $digest dirty-checking, and community evidence confirms the old AngularJS digest cycle was implicit and unscalable (angular-comm-6, angular-comm-10), motivating the shift. However, evidence is mostly marketing copy and historical complaints rather than concrete developer testimony about tracing state changes with Signals specifically.
